CCWJ is proud to present our annual seminar for 2024 on "Cobot Welding Innovation: Bridging the gap between automation and collaboration". Speakers from renowned organizations like Lincoln Electric, Miller and ABB Robotics are presenting. Cobot demonstrations are also arranged.

In-person attendees will be provided with catering and beverages for the whole day of the event. Student fees are designated to cover only the food and beverage costs.
